title: Tracy's Discord bot proves a member's address, and their Discord activity reaches /ops Signals
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout, with TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a scratch PostgreSQL, run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/discord-doors.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/discord-store.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/ops-beta.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the cases named under expect.
expect: Doors: with no DISCORD_LINK_SECRET every door is 404; a missing or wrong secret is 404 and mails nothing; the start door answers {ok:true} whether or not the beta gate admits the address; a code is the member's own, spent once, dead after expiry or too many guesses; one member is capped per hour; the username rides beside the id, cut at 32 characters.

PostgreSQL: the real migrations (080-discord-link.sql) apply; pgDiscordStore replaces codes, moves a link between members both ways and unlinks; through the three doors the round records discord.linked, one discord.bug_report per thread and discord.left in ops_signal, and nothing once the member left.
Signals: GET /api/ops/beta/signals counts discordLinked and discordBugs in totals, the window before and by Vietnam day; discord.left is not counted.
fence: x-tracy-discord-secret compared in constant time; discord_link_code apart from otp_code; discord.left removes the link so linked = holds the beta role.

tests: no secret configured: every door answers 404
a missing or wrong secret is 404, and nothing is mailed
the round: the code mailed to the address links the member and records discord.linked
beta gate on: an address the gate would refuse gets the same answer and no mail
one member cannot ask for more than its hourly codes
the Discord username rides beside the id on every signal
pgDiscordStore: codes, links moving between members, and unlink
signals: by day in Vietnam time
